title: Lot details
purpose: Review one lot, exact balance, preparation lineage and stock ledger.
summary: Review one lot: its exact balance, expiry, storage, where it was prepared from, and every stock movement.

tasks.title: Record that stock was used
steps: Enter the amount and the batch or purpose, then save. Using an expired lot needs an explicit confirmation.

tasks.title: Add more of the same lot
steps: Select [[Record receipt]] and enter the quantity received.

tasks.title: Correct the balance
steps: Select [[Record adjustment]] and enter a signed amount with a reason. Only admin and reviewer roles can adjust.
Or select [[Reverse]] on a movement row to undo that movement.

tasks.title: Retire the lot
steps: Select [[Retire lot]] and give a reason. Any remaining quantity is written off, and the lot takes no further stock movements.

good_to_know: Movements are never edited or deleted. Corrections are new rows, so the ledger keeps the whole story.
Balance is shown as recorded at each movement. Backdated movements can make it differ from a running total by date.
Use after expiry is allowed only with confirmation, and the row stays flagged Used after expiry.
Material specification shows the material's current text. It is not a frozen copy of this lot's certificate.

sections.title: Access and navigation
paragraphs: Available to active signed-in lab staff with an admin, custodian, analyst, reviewer, approver or project manager role. Client accounts and accounts without a lab role cannot open laboratory pages. Sidebar links open Lab overview, Inventory, Equipment, Training and Nonconformances. Breadcrumbs return to the list or parent record.

items.label: Lot number, state, on hand and Expires
items.description: Identity, exact amount with unit and expiry. Display state takes precedence in this order: Retired; Expired after the expiry date; Depleted at zero balance; Expiring through 30 days from today; otherwise In stock. The expiry date itself is still unexpired. The status highlight always uses 30 days even when a filter uses another window. On a lot that is not retired, Expires also carries a Due today or Due in … d pill within 30 days and an Overdue … d pill once the date has passed.

items.label: Material
items.description: Link to shared definition.

items.label: Source
items.description: Purchased / supplied or Prepared in the lab.

items.label: Vendor
items.description: Supplier or dash if absent.

items.label: Catalog / certificate reference
items.description: Optional traceability reference.

items.label: Stated concentration
items.description: Original label/certificate text and unit; no calculation or conversion.

items.label: Received / Prepared
items.description: Entered dates, shown when present.

items.label: Prepared from
items.description: Parent lot link and material, when present.

items.label: Storage
items.description: Current location and optional conditions.

items.label: Opening quantity
items.description: Original quantity; later movements do not rewrite it.

items.label: Material specification
items.description: Current shared specification, not a frozen lot certificate.

items.label: Edit
items.description: Admin, analyst and reviewer roles can correct vendor, reference, concentration, expiry and storage. Hidden on retired lots.

items.label: Record receipt
items.description: Admin, analyst and reviewer roles can add quantity to the same non-retired lot.

items.label: Record use
items.description: Admin, analyst and reviewer roles can consume stock against a batch or purpose. Expired use needs confirmation and remains flagged.

items.label: Record adjustment
items.description: Admin and reviewer roles can append a signed correction with a reason.

items.label: Retire lot
items.description: Admin and reviewer roles can write off all remaining quantity and retire with a reason. Retired lots have no stock buttons.

items.label: Reverse
items.description: Admin and reviewer roles can undo an unreversed, non-reversal movement on a non-retired lot. Cannot make balance negative.

items.label: Rows and order
items.description: Newest effective time first, then newest ID, at most 200 rows, no pagination. Earlier rows remain stored.

items.label: When
items.description: Effective time to the second, in the laboratory time zone, whose abbreviation follows the time (for example EST or EDT). Not necessarily system recording time.

items.label: Movement
items.description: Received / prepared, Used, Adjustment, Disposed or Reversal. Reversed identifies an undone original. Used after expiry preserves the flag for the use date.

items.label: Change
items.description: Signed exact amount and unit; positive adds, negative removes.

items.label: Balance
items.description: Balance after the movement was recorded, in lot unit. Backdated effective times can make displayed balances differ from a chronological running total.

items.label: Batch / purpose
items.description: Optional batch link, purpose and reason/note.

items.label: By
items.description: Person who recorded the movement.

items.label: Prepared from this lot
items.description: All child lot links, Material and Prepared date; default expiry/name/lot ordering and no cap.

items.label: Linked nonconformances
items.description: Newest 20 issues with Number link, Title and Status. Count is displayed rows. Add nonconformance preselects this lot and Standard / reagent category; an empty state appears when none are linked.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: History shows up to the latest 50 audit events, oldest of those first and the newest last. Each shows action, recorded time, actor and reason when supplied. If the record has more than 50 audit events, older events beyond this cap are not shown in this panel. They remain stored. This panel is separate from the operational ledger or timeline.

sections.title: Record footer
paragraphs: The footer repeats the record identifier and shows Viewed with the time this page was produced in the deployment time zone and the signed-in viewer. This is a viewing timestamp, distinct from creation, event, review or closure time. Numbered section headings identify panels on the record page.
